title: RT readiness and shader toolchain probe
rationale: Verify device extensions/features for ray query are enabled and the shader toolchain emits SPV_KHR_ray_query before touching the main pipeline.

edits.action: Log once after device creation: Ray Query support (YES/NO), Acceleration Structure support (YES/NO), and confirm VK_KHR_DEFERRED_HOST_OPERATIONS present in deviceExtensions.
Add a compile rule for shaders/test_ray_query.frag -> shaders/test_ray_query.spv with target env >= vulkan1.2 and GL_EXT_ray_query.

instrumentation: Optionally dump the first 2 OpExtension lines of test_ray_query.spv via spirv-dis (manual check)
acceptance: Console logs show Ray Query and Acceleration Structure support
test_ray_query.spv compiles successfully and contains SPV_KHR_ray_query ops
